name: Clyde Decker
milestones: Buried at Bethel Township, Branch County, Michigan
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Bicha-Dale Family Tree" (tree 8839537)
notes: Son of Peter and Olive Catherine (Simons) Decker.

Born 16 Sep 1888 in Northwest Township, Williams County, Ohio. He married Merle Grace Waddell on 21 Nov 1907, and Esther Shirtliff on 21 Dec 1951 at Brighton, Michigan. He died 19 Dec 1981 at Howell, Michigan, and was buried at Bethel Township, Branch County.
